I can do that — before I change your calendar I need you to confirm a few details so I don’t make an unintended change.

Planned change (please confirm):
- Event: "Northbridge onboarding sync"
- New start: Thursday, 12 March 2026 at 09:30 (Europe/Berlin)
- Time zone: Europe/Berlin
- Keep: same attendee list, same video link, no recurrence (standalone event)
- Duration/end time: keep the event’s current duration (same end time as the existing event) — confirm this, or give a new end time/duration if you want it changed
- Notifications: updating the event will send an updated invite/notification to attendees — is that OK?

If all of the above is correct, reply “Yes — reschedule” (or just “Yes”) and I’ll proceed. If any item needs to be different, tell me which part to change (for example give an end time or say not to send updates).
